verdicts.reason: A: the 'Reserve a Case' CTA has shrunk to an unreadable pill, and the body copy is set almost as large as the headline, which flips the hierarchy. The 'Limited Summer Release' eyebrow and 'Ships late June' are illegible specks, and the legal text competes in the right column. B has the same oversized body copy, unreadable eyebrow and legal clutter, but its CTA is a properly sized, readable orange button, so the action at least stands out.
